items.title: MMP
clues: I am a third party that works for advertisers.
I measure which ad led to an app install.
I sit between ad networks and the app to attribute installs.
My name means mobile measurement partner.
items.why: An MMP attributes installs and in-app events to the campaigns that drove them.

items.title: Rewarded video
clues: I give something back, like a bonus life.
I am a full-screen video ad.
Games love me for good completion.
items.why: A rewarded video is watched in exchange for a benefit inside the app.

items.title: Interstitial
clues: I appear at natural breaks, like between levels.
I am a full-screen ad that users do not choose to open.
Show me in the middle of a task and users get annoyed.
items.why: Interstitials are full-screen ads shown at natural pauses.
